description: Self-consistent field calculation for electronic ground state

ecutwfc.rule: depends on pseudopotential, typically 60-100 Ry for PW, set appropriately for LCAO

smearing_method.rule: gauss for metals, fixed for insulators

ks_solver.rule: genelpa for LCAO, cg or dav for PW

kpt.rule: Monkhorst-Pack grid, density inversely proportional to lattice parameter
